issue: The statement of Theorem 2 does not say whether the quantile index is held fixed or allowed to drift with sample size, which changes how the taper condition should be read.
scientific_consequence: Readers may apply the normality result to drifting quantile sequences where the proof does not establish it.
evidence_basis: The proof in Section 4 fixes the quantile index before applying the Lindeberg argument.
The theorem statement omits any quantifier over the quantile index.
requested_resolution: Add an explicit fixed-index quantifier to the theorem statement or justify the drifting-index reading.
